newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Samper to reshuffle cabinet again.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Samper to reshuffle cabinet again.

text.p: Colombian President Ernesto Samper plans to replace up to six members of his 15-strong cabinet in a shakeup that could occur this week, government sources said on Monday.
"It could be by the end of this week or, at the very latest, by next week," said one source, who spoke on condition that he would not be identified.
The sources said Foreign Trade Minister Morris Harf and Labour Minister Orlando Obregon were among ministers who would be ousted.
Others could include Agriculture Minister Cecilia Lopez, Communications Minister Saulo Arboleda, Development Minister Orlando Cabrales and Environment Minister Jose Vicente Mogollon.

According to local media reports, Interior Minister Horacio Serpa, Samper's right-hand man and a vocal critic of the United States, plans to step down in May to launch a bid for the presidency in elections next year.
Samper has reshuffled his cabinet regularly since he took office in August 1994 in an effort to shore up support by handing out quotas of bureaucratic power.
Only seven officials in the 15-member cabinet held their current posts a year ago.
